bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
umask 077
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/deepseek-qwen35-command-20261128
sha=54a18c494b32e2ea3d3235d9ca86abcd731e2348
test -d "$p"
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin "$sha"
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$tmp"' EXIT
git -C "$p" archive "$sha" server orchestrator | tar -x -C "$tmp"
chmod 755 "$tmp"
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid")"
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=32m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 1000:1000 -v "$tmp/server:/app/server:ro" -v "$tmp/orchestrator:/app/orchestrator:ro" --entrypoint node "$image" --test server/tests/chat.test.cjs
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,subprocess,json,re
def health(port):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(port)+'/health',timeout=3) as r:return r.status==200
 except Exception:return False
names=subprocess.check_output(['docker','ps','--format','{{.Names}}'],text=True).splitlines()
print(json.dumps({'qwen_gate_health':health(18185),'debug_ai_health':health(8787),'training_active':any(re.search(r'train|distill|optimizer|lora',n,re.I) for n in names)}))
PY
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({chat_enabled:process.env.DEBUG_AI_CHAT_ENABLED==="true",chat_access_configured:!!process.env.DEBUG_AI_CHAT_ACCESS_TOKEN,loopback:process.env.DEBUG_AI_HOST==="127.0.0.1"}))'
